test_description: Verify 'Last Write Wins' conflict resolution when modifying the same reading session on two devices while offline
business_risk: Critical - Data corruption or loss leads to user churn
preconditions: User logged in on Device A and Device B; Both devices offline; Initial session data synced
test_steps: 1. Device A: Update session page to 50 (Time T1); 2. Device B: Update session page to 60 (Time T2, where T2 > T1); 3. Connect Device A to network (Sync); 4. Connect Device B to network (Sync)
expected_result: Server records page 60; Device A receives update to page 60 upon next sync; Audit log reflects both writes
test_data_needs: Test user account; Pre-seeded reading session
tools_required: Flutter Integration Test; WireMock (Backend Stub); Network Link Conditioner
dependencies: Offline Sync Service; Isar Database; Backend Sync Endpoint
environment_requirements: Staging environment with simulated network latency
success_criteria: Final state matches latest client timestamp; No exceptions thrown
failure_impact: High - User sees inconsistent reading progress
security_considerations: Ensure Sync API requires valid JWT

test_description: Validate Free User library limit enforcement and upgrade prompt trigger
business_risk: High - Revenue leakage if limits are bypassed
preconditions: Free User account created; Library contains 20 items
test_steps: 1. Search for a new book via Google Books API; 2. Attempt to add 21st book; 3. Verify API rejection; 4. Verify Upgrade Modal appearance
expected_result: Backend returns 403 Forbidden; Frontend displays 'Limit Reached' modal with 'Upgrade' CTA
success_criteria: Item count remains 20; Upgrade flow initiates on click
security_considerations: Validate server-side enforcement prevents client bypass
accessibility_requirements: Modal focus trap; Screen reader announcements

test_description: Verify fallback behavior when OpenAI API is unavailable or rate-limited
preconditions: Premium User logged in; Recommendation requested
test_steps: 1. Simulate 503 Service Unavailable from OpenAI API; 2. User taps 'Get Recommendation'
expected_result: Polly Circuit Breaker opens; User sees graceful 'Service Busy' message; No crash
security_considerations: No API key leakage in error logs
accessibility_requirements: Error message announced to screen reader
